# Qahwa

> Qahwa is a host-controlled trivia duel app. A host signs in, picks four topics
> from a question bank, names two players, and runs a live head-to-head quiz
> board — opening questions, judging winners, and adjusting scores in real time.

## Key pages

- Landing page (/): product overview and entry point to sign in.
- Login (/login): the only account-entry route — there is no self-serve
  registration; host accounts are provisioned by an administrator.
- Dashboard (/dashboard), New game (/games/new), and the live game board
  (/games/{sessionId}) are authenticated, per-host pages and are not meant to
  be indexed or crawled — see /robots.txt.

## Notes for automated agents

- This is a client-rendered single-page app (React + Vite). Content behind
  authenticated routes is not accessible without a valid host session.
- The public marketing content lives entirely on the landing page.
